meta.title: 小小曲线调色，拿捏啦🫴！！
meta.title_en: Curve Color Grading? I've Got It!

scenes.context: 把照片扔进软件，得到一张直方图——曲线调色就从这开始。
sentences: 修图软件里这个曲线调色是啥呀？
What on earth is this curve tool in the editor?
Drop it into the photo editor.
我们就会得到一个直方图。
paraphrase: 把「可好用」换个说法
This feature comes in super handy.
「得到直方图」另一种表达
Up pops a histogram.
scenes.speak: What on earth is this curve tool in the editor? This feature is super handy. Drop it into the photo editor. We get a histogram.

scenes.title_en: Left Is Dark, Right Is Bright
scenes.context: 直方图从左到右代表照片从暗到亮——看面积在哪边判断明暗。
sentences: 从左到右代表照片从暗到亮。
From left to right, it maps dark to bright.
左边面积更大，说明整体偏暗。
More mass on the left means the photo leans dark.
你猜它大概是个什么亮度？
Guess what brightness it might be.
paraphrase: 把「映射暗到亮」换个说法
Going left to right, the chart reads shadows to highlights.
「整体偏暗」另一种表达
A heavier left side means a darker image.
scenes.speak: From left to right, it maps dark to bright. More mass on the left means the photo leans dark. It's brighter overall, right? Guess what brightness it might be.

scenes.context: 想提亮天空就拉高右侧；想加对比度就拉亮部压暗部成 S 形。
sentences: Add three points along the line.
The sky is the bright part of the photo.
Pull the right side up a bit.
形成一个 S 形的曲线。
paraphrase: 把「打点」换个说法
Set three anchors on the curve.
「提亮天空」另一种表达
Lift the right end to brighten the sky.
scenes.speak: Add three points along the line. The sky is the bright part of the photo. Pull the right side up a bit. Form an S-shaped curve.

scenes.context: 亮度曲线之外还有红绿蓝三根色彩曲线，各自控制颜色的多少。
sentences: 曲线调色一共有四根曲线。
There are four curves in total.
分别代表红色、绿色和蓝色。
They stand for red, green, and blue.
单独控制画面中这三个颜色的多少。
Each controls the amount of its color in the frame.
paraphrase: 把「代表」换个说法
One for each channel: red, green, and blue.
「控制多少」另一种表达
Each curve tunes how much of that color appears.
scenes.speak: There are four curves in total. They stand for red, green, and blue. Each controls the amount of its color in the frame.

scenes.context: 偏黄就往相反色调——加蓝再降红，颜色就调回来了。
sentences: 这张照片不想让它这么黄。
I don't want this photo so yellow.
应该往黄色的相反色调。
Move toward the opposite of yellow.
再降低红色，颜色就调过来了。
Then lower the red, and the color is fixed.
paraphrase: 把「往相反色调」换个说法
Shift toward yellow's complementary color.
「颜色调过来了」另一种表达
Tone down the red, and the cast is corrected.
scenes.speak: I don't want this photo so yellow. Move toward the opposite of yellow. We should add blue. Then lower the red, and the color is fixed.

practice: 我们就会得到一个直方图。
左边面积更大，说明整体偏暗。
More mass on the left means the photo leans dark.
Pull the right side up a bit.
再降低红色，颜色就调过来了。
Lower the red, and the color is fixed.
pitfalls: The sky is the bright of the photo.
The sky is the bright part of the photo.
part 不能漏，bright 是形容词不能直接当名词
Pull the right side up a little bit up.
Pull the right side up a bit.
up 出现一次即可，不要重复
should 后接动词原形，不加 to
S 发元音音素，冠词用 an
shifts: 打点、拉亮部、压暗部有逻辑
以为只有一根亮度曲线
亮度+红绿蓝四根曲线各管各色
footer_notes: ASR 校正说明：无重大识别误差，正文仅统一「曲线调色」等标准术语。
